name: Palo Dinner Fritto di Calamari e Gamberi (Crispy Fried Calamari & Jumbo Shrimp)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Dinner)
whyItWorks: Lightly dusted in semolina/flour and flash-fried, but frying oil, chewy squid rings, and lemon-garlic aioli make it risky during flares.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If sharing in remission, eat the tender jumbo shrimp (skip rubbery calamari tentacles), blot oil, and avoid the lemon-garlic mayo.
